name: Surabaya functional area
limitations: All eight dimensions and 31 subpillars reviewed, not fully measured. Conditional PCS/RES 40 and GSS/ISR/MED/TEC/OPT 60 require explicit core-service to full-6401, ordinary-resident, time-continuation, usual appropriate affordable access and residual-impact assumptions. LON unresolved: 49–59 mathematical domain without a centre or reliable exclusion bound. Missing household retesting does not establish continuous 2024/September contamination; June drainage defects are not measured as still failing in October. Soewandhie queue repair and another hospital radiotherapy access do not prove Soetomo waiting/rounds improved. Directory points, administrative counts and company-wide customers are not full resident coverage. All 9031 candidates and newer competitors remain retained.

dimensions.rationale: Actual pumping, local recession, fire response and housing repair coexist with June 2026 tide backflow, temporarily closed construction channels and damaged retaining walls, plus formal existing-building earthquake vulnerability. Annual average flood improvement and ordinary housing repair are not peak-event protection or seismic acceptance.
dimensions.assumption: Accept scoped physical hazards and protective gaps as materially applicable to 6401 usual residents, with relevant remaining risks still important after actual mitigation through cutoff. This is an explicit continuation/residual-impact inference, not observed October persistence of June construction failures. Effective usually affordable protection making remaining tails minor could 60, strong multi-hazard redundancy 80. Reject geography, continuation, usual reach or residual importance to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Original 2018 organized attacks and 2025 looting/burning retain harm and investigation limits. Actual enforcement, victim assistance, 2026 port operation and cross-organization rescue support functioning protection and channels. National zero-attack reporting is not local safety; gas explosion was not classified as terrorism.
dimensions.assumption: Accept usually limited direct organized-violence/regional-conflict impact on core ordinary life through cutoff, with scoped response and routes reasonably representative of 6401 and continuing. This is not safety inferred from no matching report. Important persistent coercion, unrelieved damage or route disruption could 40, stronger low-impact and effective protection evidence 80. Reject current impact, locality, reach or continuation to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Actual certificate return, legal aid, targeted assistance, multiple housing-repair actors and real flood/maritime rescue demonstrate functioning channels. Ombudsman first-half 2025 budget freeze, incomplete poverty-class appeals, aid/recovery tails and administrative closure versus actual remedy remain meaningful. Survey satisfaction is not rights restoration.
dimensions.assumption: Accept usually reachable core institutions and delivered mitigation as applicable to 6401 ordinary citizens and continuing, while observed budget/eligibility/recovery failures have not become a broader important persistent unrelieved institutional constraint. This does not establish full correction or offset any harm with volumes. Current important remedy/eligibility/recovery bottlenecks could 40; effective broad correction and alternative organizations 80. Reject locality, continuity, usual reach or residual-impact interpretation to restore unknown.

dimensions.rationale: Finished-water samples satisfy scoped panels, but separate 2024 household sampling found 71/210 E.coli and 96/210 hexavalent-chromium noncompliance; routine 1519 household E.coli tests were all compliant. September 2026 independent raw-water pollution affected customers; actual treatment, free tankers, pipe repair and partial power recovery mitigate without proving whole-household recovery. Water and power shared interruptions remain.
dimensions.assumption: Accept actual household counterevidence and 2026 pollution/common water-power stress as reasonably representative of important 6401 usual necessities, with present safe timely affordable alternatives insufficient to remove material constraints after mitigation. Missing retesting alone does not establish continuing 2024 or September contamination into October. If past defects were materially fixed and usual safe timely affordable substitution relieves current constraints, 60 is defensible, strong independent protection 80. Reject scope, current importance, continuation or inadequate-substitution assumptions to restore unknown; no supported widespread continuing basic collapse for 20.

dimensions.rationale: Actual cardiac surgery, craniotomy, dialysis and radiotherapy, June 2026 JKN radiotherapy entry, concrete usual coverage/referral paths and real queue repair support necessary care. Soetomo December 2025 waiting and rounds remain below stated targets; other-hospital repair does not prove those metrics corrected. PBI deactivation and income/residency-limited assistance are distinct from all ordinary citizens. Raw mortality/percentage/target-label contradictions are retained.
dimensions.assumption: Use the same conditional standard as Tokyo/Wuhan/Xian: accept scoped actual care and usually active-qualified JKN/referral paths as reasonably representative and continuing for appropriate necessary treatment, with usually bearable copay/noncovered/upfront costs and timely workable alternatives. Unimproved measured process weaknesses are retained; ordinary overall quality/access and residual materiality remain assumptions. Important unrelieved necessary-care/affordability/continuity constraints could 40; broader appropriate care and affordable effective backup 80. Reject locality, continuation, normal eligibility/quality/affordability or residual impact to restore unknown. Do not add perfect median bills, all quality denominators or a current universal stress test as unique prerequisites.

dimensions.rationale: Original 2017 Soetomo eight-person repeated intraventricular autologous BM-MSC implementation was nonrandomized without concurrent control; table/text/sample and visit-label discrepancies remain. The 2025 speech is not an independent efficacy result. BPOM October 2025 local inspection describes research-based treatment and future CPOB assistance, not demonstrated approval of the same current stroke protocol. Usual eligible-resident mode, net payment and continuing monitoring are unresolved.
dimensions.assumption: No anchor until a credible disease-specific human-result and current same-protocol regulatory/actual-delivery/ordinary-qualification/payment/appropriate-monitoring connection can support a reversible interpretation. Small study, missing perfect bills or research mode alone do not imply 40, illegality or no access; current important unresolved translation/access barriers after available mitigation could 40, a supported appropriate normally affordable delivered pathway 60, multiple mature accessible paths 80. Historic permission, production-quality certification and general JKN care do not presume current specific experimental coverage.

dimensions.rationale: ITS actual campus production/sales and UNAIR actual downstream products/industry connections combine with locally used mobile facilities, an actual complaint-user survey and delivered small-business assistance. Commercialization continuity/licensing challenges and high-importance low-performance app speed/reliability/procedure/outcome understanding remain alongside mitigation. Planned 200 BTS, coming-soon water and future marketing targets are not delivered; a small negative gap or missing target alone does not cap scores.
dimensions.assumption: Accept scoped multiple producer/industry connections and actual use/help as reasonably representative of 6401 core production and ordinary diffusion through cutoff, while commercialization and user-service constraints remain important after mitigation. Strong multi-actor capability and actual help making residual bottlenecks minor could 80; important broken production/use links could 40. Reject locality, continuation, usual reach or residual importance to restore unknown. No independent universal node stress test or instantly interchangeable products prerequisite; unknown high-tier facts alone do not establish 60.

dimensions.rationale: Actual Juanda routes and port use, 284 January 2026 weekend passport applications, concrete Indonesian national-visa/material requirements, lawful bank remittance and operating global backbone/retail links provide executable choices. Applications are not issued passports, national-visa processing has cross-city cost/time, FX documentation thresholds are not all-transfer caps, company totals and peak local mobile speeds are not household international continuity.
dimensions.assumption: Accept scoped operating air/sea/legal/asset/network paths as reasonably applicable to 6401 core ordinary purposes and continuing, with target citizens able to satisfy applicable lawful qualifications/materials and usually bear tickets, cross-city administration, bank and usable household connection/alternative costs. Reasonable available alternatives avoid important overall blockage while documented procedural/service weaknesses remain. Current important constraints inadequately relieved could 40; sufficiently supported effective affordable independent alternatives 80. Reject time, geographic adaptation, ordinary lawful material eligibility, affordability or actual network-substitution assumptions to restore unknown; legal or cable existence alone is insufficient.
